Quantum-chemistry output files copied from the Avogadro 1 test corpus
(`avogadro-master/testfiles/`) for parser tests.

Avogadro 1 is GPL-2.0-or-later; the `testfiles/` directory also carries a BSD-3-Clause notice
(© 2006 Jerome Pansanel), kept in this repository beside the wavefunction fixtures as
